name: thanks-calendly
description: Booking card under a thank-you hero: the event (logo, name, duration, description) beside an inline Calendly scheduler. Several tracks can be given; the first whose sessionStorage rule matches is shown (live: 'transition' vs 'implementation' demo calendars by the visitor's current-solution answer), otherwise the default. Live: the legacy pricing / trial / demo thank-you pages (bs-section--thank-you-calendar).

title.description: Heading above the card (h2), e.g. If you'd like to get a guided demo… Empty renders the card alone.

logo.description: Logo above the event name (live: the Asset Panda Pro logo).

logo_alt.description: Logo alt text (empty when decorative, as live).

logo_width.description: Logo intrinsic width in px. 0 omits it.

logo_height.description: Logo intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.

tracks.description: Calendars. Each: url (https://calendly.com/…), event_title, duration (e.g. 30 min; empty hides the clock line), body; optional when_key (a sessionStorage key) with when_values (list): the first track whose key holds one of its values is shown. The first track without when_key is the default.

hide_international.description: Hide the booking card for international visitors (html.ap-intl), as live does (its international calendar slot is empty).
